# Marketplace — suggestions & installs

> The setup agent (and, in suggest-only mode, the spec-orchestrator) records every marketplace artifact it suggests or installs here, following the `marketplace-advisor` skill. This keeps gentle offers from repeating and keeps installs auditable. Newest first.
>
> **Type:** `skill` · `agent` · `prompt` · `instruction` · `mcp` · `bundle`.
> **Status:** `suggested` (offered, not yet acted on) · `not-now` (declined for now — re-offer only if the user asks) · `installed`. **Onboarding:** `n/a` (no setup advertised) · `offered` · `done` · `declined`.

| Artifact | Type | Trigger topic | Status | Onboarding | Wired as | Date |
